Company’s Smoking Policy

Smoking cigarettes on board Company vessels is permitted only in designated smoking areas (as designated by the
Master), except under the circumstances as mentioned below.

The Master should also, in consideration of non-smokers, ensure that there is no smoking outside of the designated
smoking areas.

Smoking is NOT allowed outside designated smoking areas where there is a hazard of fire or explosion, such as:
¢ Loading, unloading or transferring of fuel, oil, or other volatile liquids.
¢ Handling any type of flammable materials: in or around paint lockers.
e« During emergency drills.

* When moored or mooring alongside docks, piers, rig platforms or other installations where smoking is
prohibited.

« Where local Policies, Procedures or Working Practices prohibit smoking,

* When the vessel is within a 500-meter safety zone or where Ports and/or Terminals have their own regulatory
safety requirement concerning smoking, The stricter of the rules shall be complied with when compared to
Company's guidelines.

Smoking in bed and smoking outside designated spaces is PROHIBITTED and violators will be subjected to
disciplinary action and/or can be dismissed by Company.

Master is also responsible for implementing and upholding this policy, although all other Officers and Crew Members
share in this responsibility with One Goal of

“ZERO HARM To People, Environment & Property”

Mr. Erwin Yosef
President Director
Date: 15 January 2023
